decisions.reason: The firm invested in the app and featured it on its home page, and pandemic-related air travel disruption is a temporary cause, so escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely.
The named public launch and established offer investment create strong commitment, and any disappointing results are attributable to the pandemic, so the firm will likely persist.
The self-service solution builds on existing capabilities and was publicly launched, so the firm will keep it to avoid writing off its investment and justifying the earlier decision.
